item: All 6 markets settle the same way
what_it_means: All 6 markets settle on the same thing: AAA's national number for ONE date (weekly = Monday, monthly = last day of month), not an average. Checked against outside AAA prints: 530 of 531 events identical. What differs is the design: days open (0.7 / 6.6 / 31), strike step (0.5c / 2c / 5-10c), close time, fees (gas monthly has maker fees), and volume (weekly and monthly trade far more per event).

The crowd prices long markets differently. Its range grows from about 1c at 1 day to 4-6c at 4-7 days and 10-39c beyond two weeks; its typical miss grows from 0.36c to about 2-4c. It leans on wholesale futures about 6x more at 4-7 days than at 1 day. Description only, not a test.
